author: Kapil Dhinwa

environment.note: All models hand-written NumPy with manual backprop; PyTorch broken in sandbox.

verification.gradcheck_method: central finite differences, float64, eps=1e-6, 6 entries/tensor
verification.gradcheck_sampling: entries with |analytic grad|>1e-4 to avoid ReLU-kink 0/0 artifacts

experiment_5M_INCOMPLETE.status: INCOMPLETE - no comparative claim at 5M scale is supported

sibling_negative_results.yantra_wiring: no gain vs random/dense/absent graph; 4 configs; delta<1pt; seed sigma 1.3-1.5
sibling_negative_results.torus_no_information_loss: FALSE: decaying scan R2~0.006 at T=128; unitary preserves norm exactly but superimposes (token0 R2 0.185->0.027)

supported_claims: Torus feature lifting: +31.8 points over raw input on synthetic cyclic task, replicated on graph-net and transformer at matched ~10K params.
Dense cross-layer wiring: +2.72 points over sequential at 20K params, 3/3 seeds positive, delta_std 0.64pt, overhead 9 scalars.
Dense wiring reduced seed variance at 20K scale (std 1.38pt -> 0.74pt).
unsupported_claims: Any advantage at 5M scale (seq baseline not run).
Any advantage on real language data or pretrained LLMs (never tested).
Novelty: DenseNet-style cross-layer connections pre-exist; this is replication/measurement.
Generalization beyond L=4, T=3, one synthetic task.
Mechanism: taps were never inspected after training; gain is unexplained.
